description:
The Department of Veterans Affairs, Financial Services Center (VA-FSC) requires medical terminology and coding training for Government employees and supervisors processing medical claims. The course shall:
• Provide a fundamental understanding of the
o various medical terminology and medical codes, and
o essential core competencies detailed in Section 4 of the PWS.
• Effectively apply to Government employees and supervisors with little or no previous experience with medical terminology and medical coding.
• Be set in a culture designed to promote innovative ways to develop employees’ understanding of basic medical terminology requirements.
• Promote knowledge retention and include innovative strategies for effective learning and continuous application, accounting for human memory, learning processes, and adult learning styles.
• Maintain and develop a Government employee and supervisor workforce capable of effectively processing customers’ medical claims.
• Be inclusive per training session/ curriculum, program materials, and a certificate upon successful completion of training for each VA-FSC attendee.

This is a new requirement.
